summary: iOS iPhone (390x844) verification of preemptive fixes applied after iteration_5. All four fixes and mobile regressions PASS. Inputs now compute >=16px on mobile (no iOS auto-zoom), hero uses svh + min-h fallback, title/favicon/viewport-fit meta correct, and no horizontal overflow or console/page errors on /, /wines, /wines/celtic-oak-cabernet-2021, /contact. critical_code_review_comments: index.css @media (max-width:640px) input,textarea,select { font-size:16px !important } is a clean, targeted fix and does not affect desktop.
h-[100svh] and h-[70svh] with min-h fallback are correctly applied and gracefully degrade on browsers without svh support.
Consider adding data-testid to Home and TrainSeries hero <section> elements for cleaner future targeting (currently had to select by class fragment).
